Kinematics W=1.7 GeV > m_eta+m_p (~1.485 GeV), Q2=1.0 GeV2, cos=0, phi=90 are physically valid for eta electroproduction
explanation: Generated a single-point eta input (maid2000, full O(alpha), electron beam 6.535 GeV, proton detected) at W=1.7, Q2=1.0, cos=0, phi=90 with vcut set to -0.1 as requested. The point is kinematically allowed. However the code's bornkin subroutine applies the inelasticity cut only when cutv > 1e-12; a negative value therefore leaves vmax at its kinematic maximum and does not apply any v-cut, contrary to the documentation comment 'negative -- v'. If the intent was an inelasticity cut, use a positive vcut (e.g., 0.166 GeV2); if the intent was a direct v-cut, this source version does not implement it via negative values.
